content.title: Ralston Cove Park Playground Renovation
content.summary: The Ralston Cove Park playground in Arvada is set for renovation in 2026 as part of the City's Taking Lasting Care (TLC) program. Community feedback was gathered through a survey open until October 31, 2025, and the project timeline includes design review in winter 2025-26, with construction expected to begin in spring/summer 2026 and completion by summer 2026.
content.body:
![small playground with a turtle climbing feature and a small play structure ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6471 "small playground with a turtle climbing feature and a small play structure ")

As part of the City's [Taking Lasting Care (TLC) program](/860), the playground at Ralston Cove Park  is getting renovated in 2026! Ralston Cove Park is located at 9602 Brooks Dr. in central Arvada, right off the Ralston Creek Trail.

The first step in the project is gathering feedback from community members about what they would like to see included in the new playground.

The Ralston Cove Park playground survey was open through Oct. 31, 2025. Thank you to everyone who participated in the survey! [Sign up for the project email list](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2019172/1717219/) to receive updates.

### [Project Email List](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2019172/1717219/ "Ralston Cove Park Email Signup")

## Playground replacement timeline

- Fall 2025: Survey open for community members to provide feedback
- Winter 2025-26: The City's Parks and Urban Design team will review the results of the survey and incorporate that feedback in to a Request for Proposal (RFP). After the solicitation closes, the City will review the proposals and select the best consultant based on their proposed design
- Spring 2026: The City will share the final playground design with the community
- Spring/Summer 2026: Construction will begin by demolishing the old playground and building the new one
- Summer 2026: Construction completed and new playground is open to the public

All dates are approximate and subject to change..
